timeline.summary: PRANAV RAVI BHARDWAJ, as promoter, declared holding 16,12,140 Sunflag Iron and Steel shares free of encumbrance on 1st April 2026.
Sunflag Iron and Steel promoters declared zero share encumbrance for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.
Sunflag Iron and Steel was declared the successful bidder for the Tambia South Coal Block in Madhya Pradesh in May 2026.
VEENA BHARDWAJ, as Promoter Group member, declared holding 35,90,281 unencumbered Sunflag Iron & Steel shares on 1st April 2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Sunflag Iron and Steel promoters submitted their annual Regulation 31(4) disclosure declaring zero share encumbrance for FY26.
Sunflag Iron & Steel Company Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹1 per equity share (10% on ₹10 face value) on May 29, 2026.
